title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1598: Invitations (2)

section.p: Su Yu sank into thought for a while, but he gave up again. He knew too little to make an accurate judgment. The Heavenly Overseer Marquis might have the answer, but from what the marquis had said, this wouldn’t be an easy fragment to get. Was it in the hands of a Daofuse? If that were the case, it would indeed be hard.
“I did hear about a secret, but one that is quite useless for me.”

As for trading the lives of those humans for his fragment… that was not happening. He would first drag it out and make the marquis wait for now. This should be enough to deter the marquis from killing those humans temporarily, holding onto the hope of making the trade.
“Who knows? This might be an act to deter me from actually making the trade.”
Something still felt wrong, so Su Yu was suspicious.
“But is there a point in this?”
Su Yu exhaled and decided to put this matter aside for now. He would wait and see. With the female furball by his side, he was not too worried about any surprises from the marquis.
Su Yu started moving.

Before long, the rapidly traveling Grandstar City arrived. Grandstar had arrived after sensing Su Yu’s exit. Su Yu wasted no time and entered the city as the city continued moving randomly in the Allheaven Battlefield.
Those observing the city in secret were left speechless.
What was this?
Was Su Yu too free? Was that it?
Or was Su Yu trying to do something here?
Before long, the massive city appeared before the Devil Realm. Instantly, several Invincibles appeared and stared at the city warily.

Su Yu appeared above the city. Wth a hearty laugh, he asked, “Is Mo Duona around? My father’s birthday celebration is happening soon. Mo Duona is invited. Please pass on my invitation to him, thank you.”
Next, a golden invitation card shot out from the city.

An Invincible caught the invitation card cautiously. After a short inspection, he noted that it was merely a regular card. On it, details about Su Long’s fiftieth birthday were written. It was a celebration of his longevity.
Fiftieth birthday. Longevity.
Yes.
The Invincible’s face twitched slightly as he said, “I will pass the invitation to him. Is this all, Mayor Su?”
Su Yu laughed, “Yes. Also, tell Mo Duona not to bother coming empty-handed. I’ll be awaiting his gifts.”
Then, the city vanished.

After some time, it appeared before the Divine Realm. Several Invincibles were already waiting there. Su Yu wasted no time and tossed an invitation card out. He said, “Zhan Wushuang is invited to my father’s birthday celebration. He’s not dead, right?”
Su Yu laughed and said, “Quite a lot of divines survived, right? Thank me. You owe me for this high survival rate.”
An Invincible said, “Wushuang will be there. However, Wushuang and the others have sustained some willpower injuries. Mayor Su, would you show your generosity and help with their injuries?”

Su Yu grinned, “I warned you guys not to get involved in the previous battle, but you were stubborn. This is a small matter. I’ll help Zhan Wushuang with his recovery during the celebration. It’s an easy job with some characters. You guys could have done this yourself. You only needed to enter his sea of willpower to do the same.”
What a stupid suggestion.
Would Zhan Wushuang agree to that?
They would have solved the issue long ago if he were willing to allow that.
“We will be troubling you, Mayor Su.”
Zhan Wushuang’s sea of willpower had been injured. Thus, it wouldn’t matter for him to enter the Human Realm. At this rate, he would become a cripple anyway. He might as well take the risk and go.
Su Yu continued roaming the Allheaven Battlefield.
Dragon Realm.
Facing several furious dragon Invincibles, Su Yu smiled and said, “Brother Long Wuyou is invited to my father’s birthday celebration. I still remember our short friendship not long ago.”
Before long, the Five Elemental Realm received the invitation as well.

That was not all. Almost all the people on the Heaven Index were invited, including even the nether and the stone golem. In fact, even the immortals received an invitation. However, he did not specify anyone to attend the celebration for the immortals since they had lost too many people as of late.
“Just what is he doing?”

Many experts were confused. Just what was Su Yu trying to do? His father was only fifty. What manner of longevity celebration was that? Was Su Yu taking himself for the ruler of the Myriad Realms already?
Eastern sector.
Eastrift Valley.
Great Qin King asked, “Is this too rash?”
Great Zhou King said, “This is a good thing. With this, he would have everyone’s attention.”
“I can’t believe Su Yu is really inviting all those people. What is he thinking?”
Great Qin King was quite surprised by what Su Yu was doing. He had thought that Su Yu wouldn’t bother inviting all those people, but he was wrong.
Great Zhou King smiled and said, “He is definitely unaware of our goal, but he definitely has his own goal to achieve here. Let him be. It won’t matter as long as it doesn’t interfere with our plan.”
“Do we tell him the plan?” Great Qin King asked, “Things could get out of hand.”
Great Zhou King thought about it and said, “We’ll tell him after teleporting away.”
“Sure.”
Great Qin King asked, “How long can your fake characters last?”
“Not for long. Around ten minutes and they will run out of energy.”
“Around ten minutes…”
Great Qin King nodded, “That’s enough for us to do many things.”
After a short pause, he continued, “Don’t leak this to anyone. Only the two of us can know this.”
“I know.”
Great Zhou King nodded. He stared at Great Qin King for a long while before asking, “Who do you think it would be?”
Great Qin King sank into silence.
Great Zhou King continued, “Tiangu might have said those words to incite disharmony, but…have you never doubted anyone?”
Great Qin King asked, “And what about it?”
“We need to drag the traitor out.”

Great Zhou King said, “We can’t be on the defensive all the time. The traitor’s target is clear for all to see. It’s the multiple character faction. That is all. This might be related to Culture King. I can’t think of any other reason.”

Great Qin King asked, “You should have several suspects, right? The traitor might even be one of your supporters. Great Zhou wouldn’t have turned into the hotbed of anti multiple character faction so easily otherwise.”
Thus, many believed that the traitor would either be Great Zhou King or one of his supporters.

Great Zhou King said, “I have several suspects, but I can’t do or say anything rashly. We can’t acknowledge the fact that there is a second traitor. Even after discovering the traitor, we must deal with it in the dark. We can even create an accident for the traitor to die gloriously as a martyr. We can’t let anyone know about this.”
The truth couldn’t be leaked. Otherwise, people would start wondering if there was a third traitor as well. Trust between fellow humans would be ruined completely.
Great Qin King nodded. After a slight hesitation, Great Zhou King said, “Or…we can even let all my suspects die gloriously during our upcoming mission.”
Great Qin King blanked out slightly. He stared at Great Zhou King and said, “You…Old Zhou…”
Great Zhou King smiled and said, “Yes? Can’t bear parting with them?”

“No. But…some of them are innocent. I can’t accept letting them die because of a traitor.” Great Qin King said, “It’s understandable for some to die in combat, but I can’t accept letting these people die because of the betrayal of their own. Nobody can accept this. Old Zhou, either we determine who the traitor is with absolute certainty before acting, or we don’t act. I know your idea is a feasible solution, but…I am unwilling. These are heroes of humanity. They have fought alongside us for many years.”

Great Zhou King sighed and said nothing else. Perhaps this was the source of Great Qin King’s unique charm. Yes, this was a decent idea. Since they were going to let the traitor die in battle, the safest option was to let all the suspects die in battle. That was the most straightforward method.
However, Great Qin King was unwilling to let the heroes die alongside the traitor. He was unwilling to taint the name of the heroes who had sacrificed so much for humanity.
Great Zhou King sank into thought, thinking of a way to discover the traitor.
Would Su Yu’s return change anything?

Su Yu was the current top expert of the multiple character faction. He had surpassed even Wan Tiansheng. He was monstrously talented, with powerful backers behind him. So talented was he that even Great Qin King had announced him as the future human leader. This could very well be enough to lure the traitor into doing something upon Su Yu’s return.

As Great Zhou King considered numerous ideas, he said, “We will wait for Su Yu’s return. Since he has sent all those invitations out, he would most likely return. We can discuss this matter with him then.”

His cooperation might be required to lure the traitor out. Upon discovering the traitor, they didn’t need to do anything to alert the traitor. They only needed to take the traitor to the Celestial Chasm Realm and allow the traitor to die in combat.
This was the cleanest method of dealing with the traitor. They couldn’t afford to threaten the fragile unity of humanity again.
